title: Experimental Data Analysis & Simulation Validation Workflow
description: Fits raw experimental data and runs a theoretical simulation in parallel, joins them for a goodness-of-fit comparison, loops model-parameter revision until the fit is acceptable, and gates the final conclusions behind PI/advisor sign-off before the lab report is generated.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: experimental-data-analysis-simulation-validation-workflow
  title: Experimental Data Analysis & Simulation Validation Workflow
  description: Fits raw experimental data and runs a theoretical simulation in parallel, joins them
    for a goodness-of-fit comparison, loops model-parameter revision until the fit is acceptable,
    and gates the final conclusions behind PI/advisor sign-off before the lab report is generated.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: "Fits raw experimental data and runs a theoretical simulation in parallel, joins them for
    a goodness-of-fit comparison, loops model-parameter revision until the fit is acceptable, and
    gates the final conclusions behind PI/advisor sign-off before the lab report is generated.
    Trigger: user submits raw measurement data with uncertainties plus a theoretical model
    description"
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: stop
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n7
  nodes:
    - id: n1
      kind: input
      name: Data & Model Intake
      summary: Data & Model Intake
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The user's objective, source text, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - raw_measurements
              - measurement_uncertainties
              - theoretical_model_description
            properties:
              raw_measurements: {}
              measurement_uncertainties: {}
              theoretical_model_description: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-07
      name: Clean & Fit Experimental Data
      summary: Clean & Fit Experimental Data
      role: Experimental physicist specializing in lab-data analysis, curve fitting, and uncertainty
        propagation.
      prompt: You are an Experimental Data Analyst agent. You clean raw experimental data and fit it to a
        theoretical model with proper treatment of measurement uncertainty — error bars, weighted
        least-squares fitting — rather than a bare unweighted fit that ignores how precisely each
        point was actually measured. You propagate uncertainty correctly through any derived
        quantities instead of ignoring it, and you report goodness-of-fit statistics (reduced
        chi-square, residual patterns) so the user knows whether the model is actually supported by
        the data or merely plotted alongside it without a real statistical check.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - statistical-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
          - observability
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-05
      name: Run Theoretical Simulation / Model Prediction
      summary: Run Theoretical Simulation / Model Prediction
      role: Computational physicist building and running numerical simulations of physical systems.
      prompt: You are a Physics Simulation & Numerical Modeling Agent. When an analytic solution isn't
        tractable, you build a numerical model — finite-difference, finite-element, Monte Carlo, or
        direct ODE/PDE integration, as appropriate to the system — and choose a numerical method and
        step size justified by the problem's stability and accuracy requirements rather than an
        arbitrary default. Before trusting a simulation's output on the full problem, you validate
        it against a known analytic limit or a conservation law (energy, momentum) the true system
        must obey, and you report the simulation's estimated numerical error alongside its result.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - quantitative-analysis
          - simulation
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n4
      kind: join
      name: Merge Empirical Fit + Simulated Prediction
      summary: Merge Empirical Fit + Simulated Prediction
      config:
        join: all
    - id: n5
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Compare Data vs Model (Goodness-of-Fit)
      summary: Evaluate chi square reduced.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result using chi square reduced. Return a score, pass/fail verdict,
        evidence, uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic
        measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n6
      kind: condition
      name: Good Fit
      summary: Good Fit
      config:
        expression: 0.8 <= fit_score.reduced_chi_square <= 1.2
        branches:
          - label: "True"
            when: "true"
          - label: "False"
            when: "false"
    - id: n8
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-05
      name: Revise Model Parameters
      summary: Revise Model Parameters
      role: Computational physicist building and running numerical simulations of physical systems.
      prompt: You are a Physics Simulation & Numerical Modeling Agent. When an analytic solution isn't
        tractable, you build a numerical model — finite-difference, finite-element, Monte Carlo, or
        direct ODE/PDE integration, as appropriate to the system — and choose a numerical method and
        step size justified by the problem's stability and accuracy requirements rather than an
        arbitrary default. Before trusting a simulation's output on the full problem, you validate
        it against a known analytic limit or a conservation law (energy, momentum) the true system
        must obey, and you report the simulation's estimated numerical error alongside its result.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - quantitative-analysis
          - simulation
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n_loop8
      kind: loop
      name: Revise Model Until Good Fit
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until good fit achieved.
      config:
        body:
          - n3
          - n4
          - n5
          - n6
          - n8
        exitCondition: good fit achieved
        maxIterations: 5
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n7
      kind: approval
      name: PI/Advisor Sign-off on Conclusions
      summary: Pause for principal investigator / advisor; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: n10
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-07
      name: Generate Lab Report with Figures
      summary: Generate Lab Report with Figures
      role: Experimental physicist specializing in lab-data analysis, curve fitting, and uncertainty
        propagation.
      prompt: You are an Experimental Data Analyst agent. You clean raw experimental data and fit it to a
        theoretical model with proper treatment of measurement uncertainty — error bars, weighted
        least-squares fitting — rather than a bare unweighted fit that ignores how precisely each
        point was actually measured. You propagate uncertainty correctly through any derived
        quantities instead of ignoring it, and you report goodness-of-fit statistics (reduced
        chi-square, residual patterns) so the user knows whether the model is actually supported by
        the data or merely plotted alongside it without a real statistical check.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - statistical-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
          - observability
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Validated result
      summary: Return the completed experimental data analysis & simulation validation workflow
        deliverable, validation evidence, and unresolved uncertainty.
  edges:
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-1
      from: n1
      to: n2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-2
      from: n1
      to: n3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-3
      from: n2
      to: n4
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-4
      from: n3
      to: n4
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-5
      from: n4
      to: n5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-6
      from: n5
      to: n6
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-7
      from: n6
      to: n7
      kind: control
      condition: "true"
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-8
      from: n6
      to: n_loop8
      kind: control
      condition: "false"
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-9
      from: n_loop8
      to: n7
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-phys-02-edge-10
      from: n7
      to: n10
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-phys-02-output-1
      from: n8
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
    - id: wf-phys-02-output-2
      from: n10
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
